messages:
Marta Gomez: Quick question — for cross-hosting requests, do we have a clear authz fallthrough when private control plane can't reach KMS? If private can't reach customer KMS, should we block or fall back to hosted KMS token proxy?
Ethan Li: I think we should block by default for security, but allow an operator flag for 'emergency-proxy' with audit logs. :warning:
Priya Nair: Blocking by default agrees with compliance. But for Dedicated customers we sometimes provide a managed KMS — for those we can allow proxy. We need capability flags in the manifest.
Sam O'Neill: +1. Manifest suggestion: `security.kmsMode: [customer_managed|redwood_proxy|read_only_cache]` and `fallthroughPolicy: [deny|proxy|degraded]` — store in FCD so adapters can honor.
Marta Gomez: That means runtime adapters in hosted/dedicated/private must implement `Authorize(kmsIntent) -> AuthorizationOutcome` and surface `canProxy` boolean. We should define the gRPC contract.
Ethan Li: Watch out for race: private control plane transiently unreachable -> we shouldn't silently flip to proxy without explicit operator consent. Add TTL and operator approval.
Priya Nair: Also need telemetry: emit `kms.fallthrough.requested` + `kms.fallthrough.granted|denied` with reason codes. Console can show spikes.
Sam O'Neill: Implementation detail: for latency SLOs, if proxy path adds 300ms, routing policy should prefer dedicated variants. Suggest adding `costLatencyTradeoff` hint in capability manifest.
Marta Gomez: For canary rollouts across hosting modes, we need consistent error semantics. e.g., if hosted returns 429 and dedicated returns 503, client sees inconsistent behavior. Proposal: adapter should canonicalize into `InferenceError{class:RateLimited|Unavailable|Internal, hosting:...}` in the consent layer.
Ethan Li: Agree. That canonical error shape helps console and SDKs decide fallbacks automatically.
Priya Nair: One more: config drift between control planes — we need versioned manifests and a compatibility check during handshake. If manifest schema mismatch >major -> reject connect and log.
Sam O'Neill: Ok. Action items: write minimal gRPC proto for Authorize + CapabilityDiscovery (`/cc @Marta Gomez @Ethan Li`) and add telemetry events. I'll start a draft RFC.
Marta Gomez: Thanks — can you add a short test plan for failure modes (kms down, manifest mismatch, transient authz deny)? I'll sketch quick unit tests and an integration test harness.
deploy-bot: Created thread rfc-2180001123-deploy-surface-authz-proxy-draft in docs repo.
Marta Gomez: Linking draft: https://git.internal/reedoc/rfcs/2180001123-kms-fallthrough.md
Priya Nair: Ping me when draft is up, I'll run compliance review.
Ethan Li: Nice. Closing for now — we can iterate on proto in RFC.
